description: The plot titled "ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with Gazeta dataset" illustrates the performance of two models, MBart and T5, as they are fine-tuned with adapters of varying sizes, denoted by 'r'. The x-axis represents the size of the adapter 'r', which is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 9. The y-axis measures the ROUGE-1 metric, which is a measure of the quality of text summarization, with values ranging from 0 to 35. The plot shows four lines, each representing a different combination of model and adapter size. The red line represents the T5 model with the LoRA adapter, the green line represents the T5 model with the AdaLoRA adapter, the purple line represents the MBart model with the LoRA adapter, and the orange line represents the MBart model with the AdaLoRA adapter. The lines show that as the size of the adapter increases, the ROUGE-1 metric also increases, indicating better summarization performance. The T5 model with the AdaLoRA adapter consistently performs the best across all adapter sizes, followed by the T5 model with the LoRA adapter. The MBart model with the AdaLoRA adapter shows a significant increase in performance as the adapter size increases, while the MBart model with the LoRA adapter shows a more gradual increase.
